events.description: Two players (one in dark blue/black, one in blue/yellow) are engaged in a physical altercation on the ice, with grappling and pushing visible.

After the initial fight, the player in dark blue/black is on the ice and appears helpless while the opposing player (blue/yellow, #91) continues to engage physically, including leaning over and making contact while the referee intervenes.
A second player in blue/yellow (possibly #24 or another teammate) joins the scuffle, engaging with the downed player and the referee, escalating the physical confrontation.

The downed player remains on the ice while multiple opponents (including #91 and another Blues player) continue to apply pressure and physical contact, with the referee struggling to separate them — indicating continued aggression toward a non-resisting individual.

Two players engage in physical combat: the player in blue (No. 8) and the player in white (No. 24) make forceful contact, with the blue player delivering a check that causes both to lose balance; by f7 (91.5s), the blue player is falling and the white player is still engaged, indicating mutual physical struggle rather than incidental contact.

Multiple players from opposing teams engage in a violent on-ice brawl near the boards, with punches thrown, grappling, and helmets being dislodged; visible participants include #91 Tarasenko (STL), #14 Ekholm (NSH), and #10 Varnakrok (NSH).

A multi-player on-ice fight erupts near the boards, involving players from both teams (Nashville Predators in white/gold and St. Louis Blues in blue/yellow), with punches thrown, grappling, and players falling to the ice; referees intervene progressively to separate the combatants.

Multiple players from opposing teams (St. Louis Blues in blue/yellow and Nashville Predators in white/gold) are engaged in a physical altercation near the boards, with referees intervening to separate them. Player #91 (Tarasenko, Blues) is central to the scuffle, grappling with opponents while being restrained by officials and teammates. The fight involves pushing, grabbing, and close-quarters shoving over several seconds.
Two hockey players engage in a prolonged physical fight along the boards, escalating to the ice where they grapple and throw punches until separated by officials.
